keep.text: Internet pe har doosra aadmi aapko bata raha hai ki roti chhod do.

But roti chhodo mat. Par ye samajhna bahut zyada zaroori hai ki gehun ke andar hota kya hai. Gehun ke andar ek protein hota hai jisko kehte hain gluten, aur ye wahi cheez hai jiski wajah se gehun elastic banta hai, yaani ki aata elastic banta hai. Aur isi wajah se roti phoolti hai, isi wajah se paratha bahut achhe se stretch hota hai, isi wajah se
pizza ka dough stretch hota hai.
Ab originally gluten gehun mein 5-6% hota tha.
Roti isi pe banti thi, paratha bhi isi pe banta tha.
Par phir companies aayi badi badi,
aur inhe chahiye tha softest bread,
fluffiest ekdam croissant,
aur longest shelf life wala aata.
Unhone genetically modify kar diya saare ke saare gehun ko.
Aur aaj gehun mein gluten 10 se 15% ho gaya, yaani 3 guna se bhi zyada.
Ab aapki body mein ek enzyme hota hai, isko bolte hain dipeptidyl peptidase, aur ye enzyme gluten ko todta hai,
digest karta hai. Par ye enzyme
5% gluten ko digest karne ke liye bana hua hai.
Aur aaj hum load kar dete hain body mein 15% gluten,
teen guna se bhi zyada.

Enzyme ekdam exhaust ho jaata hai, aur exhausted enzyme ekdam thaka hua rehta hai. Jab enzyme thak jaata hai toh gluten adhoora toot jaata hai, aur adhoora toota hua gluten gut ki jo lining hoti hai usko irritate karta hai,
usko pareshaan karta hai. Aur yahan se shuru hota hai ek chain reaction:
gas, bloating, acidity...
Kuch logon ko toh skin pe bhi dikhne lagta hai, jaise inflammation hone lagti hai skin pe, acne aane lagte hain,
angry skin aa jaati hai.
Aur ye saari galtiyan gehun ki nahi hain, ye saari galti modified gehun ki hai. Aur ye samajhna bahut zyada zaroori hai.
Ab sawaal ye hai ki aapki body mein ye enzyme kitni der tak active rehta hai?
Aapke liye kaun sa grain sahi hai, bajra, jau, ragi,
kaun si aapki body accept karegi?

Ye saari cheezein personalized hoti hain, har body ki alag-alag. Mere health protocol mein maine ye poora ka poora system banaya hua hai. Apni body ko samajhna, apne grains select karna, enzyme load karna. Kyunki main ye khud apni body pe kar chuka hoon. 110 kg se 85 kg tak aa chuka hoon main pichhle
45 se 46 din mein.
Mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka hai. You are watching FitFinfluencer. Milte hain next video mein!
